text.p: Britain's Trish Johnson hit a hole-in-one and nine birdies to beat the European women's Tour low-score record with an 11-under-par 62 in the French Open on Friday.

"There was polite applause from the crowd when my tee-shot pitched 10 feet past the flag but it turned into a roar when the ball spun back into the hole," said Johnson of her ace at the 121-yards 14th.
It was a third low round from Johnson in her last five tournaments. She shot a 64 on her way to winning the European Open last month and then another 64 to win in North Carolina.
Johnson's score on the opening day here left her six strokes clear of compatriot Sally Prosser and Spain's Raquel Carriedo.
